where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

if.test: district != null and district != '' and district != '全部区域'
branchType != null and branchType != '' and branchType != 'all'

where.if: AND (type <> 'community' OR (avg_price IS NOT NULL AND avg_price >= #{minPrice}))
AND (type <> 'community' OR (avg_price IS NOT NULL AND avg_price <= #{maxPrice}))
AND (type <> 'community' OR (built_year IS NOT NULL AND built_year >= #{minYear}))
AND (type <> 'community' OR (built_year IS NOT NULL AND built_year <= #{maxYear}))

if.test: west != null and east != null and south != null and north != null

where.if: AND lng BETWEEN #{west} AND #{east} AND lat BETWEEN #{south} AND #{north}

mapper.select: SELECT type, COALESCE(branch_type, '') AS branchType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM v_poi GROUP BY type, branch_type
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district) FROM v_poi WHERE district <> ''
SELECT brand AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM v_poi WHERE type = 'bank' AND brand <> '' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY value DESC, label LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN avg_price IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN avg_price < 50000 THEN '< 5 万' WHEN avg_price < 70000 THEN '5–7 万' WHEN avg_price < 90000 THEN '7–9 万' WHEN avg_price < 110000 THEN '9–11 万' ELSE '≥ 11 万' END AS label FROM v_poi WHERE type = 'community' ) t GROUP BY label
SELECT FLOOR(lng / 0.02) AS gx, FLOOR(lat / 0.02) AS gy, COUNT(*) AS value FROM v_poi WHERE type = 'bank' GROUP BY gx, gy ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
